attchmntText: Winsome Yarns Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Winsome Yarns Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting on November 12, 2026. The company reported a loss after tax of 1,330 lakhs for the quarter and 1,662 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were negative 1.88 rupees for the quarter and negative 2.35 rupees for the half year. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process, with the NCLT approving a resolution plan from Mohini Health and Hygiene Limited on April 16, 2026. The plan value is 162.90 crore. The auditor issued a qualified conclusion due to pending balance confirmations and adjustments related to tax cases. The company’s registered office was vacated on December 30, 2024, and it currently operates from Mohali.

attchmntText: The Exchange had sought clarification from Winsome Yarns Limited for the quarter ended 31-Mar-2025 with respect to Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
